title: Descent of a flat complex with proper support
statement: Let I be a directed set and let (S_i)_{i\in I} be an inverse system of quasi-compact, quasi-separated schemes with affine transition morphisms, where S_i=\operatorname{Spec}(R_i) for Noetherian rings R_i, and let S=\varprojlim_i S_i=\operatorname{Spec}(R). Let X_i be a finitely presented S_i-scheme [def-pc-scheme] and write X=X_i\times_{S_i}S. Let G^\bullet be a bounded complex of finitely presented \mathcal{O}_X-modules flat over S [def-pc-morphism-conventions, def-pc-base-change], with every term having support proper over S [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base]. Then there are j\geq i and a bounded complex G_j^\bullet of finitely presented \mathcal{O}_{X_j}-modules flat over S_j, where X_j=X_i\times_{S_i}S_j, such that every term has support proper over S_j and the base change of G_j^\bullet to X is isomorphic to G^\bullet.

source.place: Lemma 32.10.2, Tag 01ZR; Lemma 32.10.4, Tag 05LY; Lemma 32.13.5, Tag 081G, together with Cohomology of Schemes Lemma 30.26.7

proof.text: Apply the bounded-complex descent statement to the finitely presented scheme X_i and the bounded complex G^\bullet. After increasing i, obtain a bounded complex G_i^\bullet of finitely presented O_{X_i}-modules flat over Spec(R_i), together with an isomorphism from its base change to G^\bullet.

Apply eventual proper-support descent to each already chosen term of G_i^\bullet. Each term is finitely presented and its base change has proper support by hypothesis. Since only finitely many terms are nonzero, directedness gives one later stage where every base-changed term has proper support. Base-changing the whole complex retains its differentials, boundedness, finite presentation, flatness, and identification with G^\bullet.
